_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to its tagged 0.54.0 (describe: and references:, parse errors that say what fits, update! on named results, row caps, faster typing); beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.74.0 (run every query, recipes from the Library, a quieter agent timeline, describe:/references: results). beamlynx-ui 0.74.0 needs pine-lang 0.54 (its RequiredVersion).
